cards.title: Preview list rows in forced dark and light schemes
cards.when: Use this when you are building or editing a list view and want fast visual checks in both color schemes inside Xcode, then a runtime check that rows meet the size target.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn 'colorScheme, .dark' Sources/Lists
grep -c '#Preview' Sources/Lists/ListView.swift
xcodebuild test -scheme Lists -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:ListsUITests/ListRowSchemeTests

cards.title: Replace hard-coded list colors with semantic colors
cards.when: Use this when a list view contains fixed RGB or UIColor values that do not adapt to dark mode.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn 'Color(red' Sources/Lists
grep -rn 'UIColor(' Sources/Lists
grep -rn 'Color(red' Sources/Lists
xcodebuild test -scheme Lists -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:ListsUITests/ListContrastTests

cards.title: Inventory existing input widgets before planning loading
cards.when: Use at the start of the plan stage when the app already has text inputs and you must decide where loading state belongs.
cards.cmds:
tree -L 2 src
rg -n "Input|on_input_submitted" src
grep -n textual pyproject.toml
touch PLAN_LOADING.md
pytest -q

cards.title: Decide whether input stays editable during loading
cards.when: Use when the plan must say if the user can type into the input while a request is running.
cards.cmds:
rg -n disabled src
cat PLAN_LOADING.md
rg -n on_input_submitted src
wc -l src/app.py
pytest -q

cards.title: Define a typed status prop for the table in Svelte 5
cards.when: Deciding how the table component receives its loading, empty, error, or ready state from the parent.
cards.cmds:
npm ls svelte
rg -n '\$props' src/lib
npx svelte-check --threshold error

cards.title: Plan a svelte:boundary around the table for render failures
cards.when: Deciding how to contain a rendering crash inside the table so the rest of the page keeps working.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'svelte:boundary' src
npm ls svelte
grep -c 'svelte:boundary' docs/table-states.md

cards.title: Plan empty-state copy, action, and contrast limits
cards.when: Writing the empty-state section of the table plan so it has one message and one action that meet accessibility limits.
cards.cmds:
grep -c -E 'heading|message|button' docs/table-states.md
npx axe http://localhost:5173/users

cards.title: Plan loading delay and retry behavior with a test file
cards.when: Deciding when the spinner appears and how the retry button behaves, then reserving a test file to prove both.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/table-states.spec.ts
ls tests

cards.title: Plan a mobile-first grid for the empty-state container
cards.when: Use this when the empty state sits inside a grid or list and must reflow from one column to several without guessing media query values.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'display: grid' styles.css
grep -n '@media (width' styles.css

cards.title: Plan container queries for the empty-state card
cards.when: Use this when the empty-state card appears in sidebars and main panels of different widths, so its layout must respond to its own container instead of the viewport.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn 'container-type' .
grep -rn '@container' styles.css

cards.title: Plan touch targets and text sizing for the call-to-action
cards.when: Use this when the empty state has a button or link that must be easy to tap on phones and readable at every width.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'button' index.html
grep -n 'min-height' styles.css

cards.title: Plan contrast and reduced-motion for the empty state
cards.when: Use this when the empty state has text, an icon, or an animation that must meet accessibility limits at every breakpoint.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn 'prefers-reduced-motion' .
grep -n 'color' styles.css

cards.title: Full-width select on mobile, auto width from sm
cards.when: Use when a select must fill the screen width on phones and shrink to content width on tablets and desktops.
cards.cmds:
npm ls tailwindcss
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o ./dist/output.css
grep -c sm:w-auto src/index.html
grep -c w-auto dist/output.css

cards.title: Keep select text 16px on mobile to stop iOS zoom
cards.when: Use when a select appears on phones where iOS Safari zooms in on any form control with font-size below 16px.
cards.cmds:
npm ls tailwindcss
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o ./dist/output.css
grep -c font-size: 1rem dist/output.css

cards.title: Replace native select arrow with responsive custom chevron
cards.when: Use when the design needs one consistent arrow across browsers and the right padding must grow at larger breakpoints.
cards.cmds:
npm install -D @tailwindcss/forms
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o ./dist/output.css
grep -c appearance dist/output.css

cards.title: Stack label above select, row layout from md
cards.when: Use when a form row has a label and a select that must stack on narrow screens and sit side by side on wider ones.
cards.cmds:
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o ./dist/output.css
grep -c md:flex-row src/index.html

cards.title: Responsive grid of selects, one to three columns
cards.when: Use when several selects sit in a filter panel that should reflow from one column on phones to three columns on wide screens.
cards.cmds:
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o ./dist/output.css --minify
grep -o grid-cols-[0-9] src/index.html

cards.title: Size select by container width with container queries
cards.when: Use when a select sits in a card or sidebar whose width differs from the viewport, so it should respond to its parent and not the window.
cards.cmds:
npx @tailwindcss/cli -i ./src/input.css -o ./dist/output.css
grep -c @container dist/output.css
grep -c sm:w- src/sidebar.html

cards.title: Inventory existing empty-state markup and its breakpoints
cards.when: Use this first when an HTML/CSS project already has an empty-state block and you need to know what exists before planning changes.
cards.cmds:
grep -rln 'empty-state' .
grep -n 'empty-state' styles.css
grep -c '@media' styles.css
grep -c '44px' styles.css

cards.title: Write and validate the responsive plan file
cards.when: Use this at the end of planning to save the decided breakpoints, sizes, and layout choices into one file that the build stage reads.
cards.cmds:
ls docs
mkdir -p docs
touch docs/empty-state-responsive-plan.md
stat docs/empty-state-responsive-plan.md
wc -l docs/empty-state-responsive-plan.md
grep -c '44px' docs/empty-state-responsive-plan.md

cards.title: Verify ratatui split layout at 80x24 and 40x12
cards.when: Use this when a ratatui app switches between side-by-side and stacked layouts by terminal width and you must prove both modes with cargo test.
cards.cmds:
cd tui-app
grep -n ratatui Cargo.toml
grep -n TestBackend::new tests/layout.rs
cargo test --test layout responsive
cargo test

cards.title: Check ratatui breakpoint at width 79 and 80
cards.when: Use this when a ratatui layout switches modes at a fixed column threshold and an off-by-one at that boundary would break the design.
cards.cmds:
cd tui-app
grep -rn WIDE_MIN src
cargo test breakpoint_at_79_is_compact
cargo test breakpoint_at_80_is_wide

cards.title: Verify Textual layout reflows with run_test sizes
cards.when: Use this when a Textual app uses Horizontal and Vertical containers with fr units and must reflow when the terminal is resized.
cards.cmds:
cd dashboard
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
pytest tests/test_responsive.py -k narrow -v
pytest tests/test_responsive.py -k wide -v
grep -n region.width tests/test_responsive.py

cards.title: Verify minimum-size fallback message in ratatui
cards.when: Use this when a ratatui app must show a too-small notice below a minimum size instead of drawing a broken layout.
cards.cmds:
cd tui-app
grep -rn MIN_WIDTH src
cargo test too_small_fallback
cargo test at_minimum_size_draws_widgets
grep -rn "too small" tests

cards.title: Verify table dark theme uses no hardcoded colors
cards.when: Use this after a React table gets dark mode, to confirm every color comes from CSS variables.
cards.cmds:
rg -n '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,6}' src/components/DataTable.tsx
npx eslint src/components/DataTable.tsx
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Test table theme switch with Playwright
cards.when: Use this when a React table switches between light and dark through a data-theme attribute and you need proof that the computed colors change.
cards.cmds:
curl -I http://localhost:5173/table
npx playwright test tests/table-theme.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Check table dark mode contrast with axe
cards.when: Use this after building dark mode for a table, to confirm text and header contrast meets WCAG AA in the dark theme.
cards.cmds:
curl -I http://localhost:5173/table?theme=dark
npx @axe-core/cli http://localhost:5173/table?theme=dark --tags wcag2aa --exit

cards.title: Unit test the theme provider used by tables
cards.when: Use this when a table reads the current theme from a React context and you need to prove the provider switches values correctly.
cards.cmds:
npx vitest run src/theme/ThemeProvider.test.tsx
rg -n 'useTheme' src/components/DataTable.tsx
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Count CSS variable coverage for table theme
cards.when: Use this to confirm the table stylesheet defines every theme token it uses, and that the root element declares color-scheme.
cards.cmds:
rg -c 'var\(--table-' src/components/DataTable.module.css
rg -n 'color-scheme' src/styles/globals.css
npx prettier --check src/components/DataTable.module.css

cards.title: Measure table theme toggle time under 200ms
cards.when: Use this when a large React table re-renders on theme change and you need proof the switch stays fast.
cards.cmds:
curl -I http://localhost:5173/table
npx playwright test tests/theme-toggle-timing.spec.ts --reporter=line
rg -n 'memo' src/components/DataTable.tsx

cards.title: Render a placeholder when the chart has no data
cards.when: Use this when the chart receives an empty data slice so it shows a message instead of blank axes.
cards.cmds:
rg -n fn draw_chart src/ui/chart.rs
cargo test chart_empty_renders_placeholder

cards.title: Show error messages in a red bordered panel
cards.when: Use this when a data fetch or parse fails and the chart area must show the error text instead of a chart.
cards.cmds:
rg -n Paragraph src/ui
cargo test chart_error_shows_message

cards.title: Guard axis bounds against single-point ranges
cards.when: Use this when computing chart axis bounds from data that may contain one value or all identical values.
cards.cmds:
rg -n bounds src/ui/chart.rs
cargo test axis_bounds_single_point

cards.title: Render a too-small message instead of panicking
cards.when: Use this when the chart area can shrink below the size needed for axes and a border, such as in a split pane.
cards.cmds:
rg -n fn draw src/ui
cargo test chart_tiny_area_no_panic
cargo fmt -- --check

cards.title: Drop non-finite points before building the dataset
cards.when: Use this when chart data may contain NaN or infinite values from division or failed parsing, which would otherwise break the line.
cards.cmds:
rg -n Dataset src/ui
cargo test chart_drops_nan_points
cargo clippy -- -D warnings

cards.title: Snapshot-test Textual screens at fixed terminal sizes
cards.when: Use this when a Textual screen must keep an exact character layout at several fixed sizes and any change should show up as a diff.
cards.cmds:
cd dashboard
pip show pytest-textual-snapshot
pytest tests/test_snapshots.py -k size_80x24 --snapshot-update
pytest tests/test_snapshots.py -k size_80x24
ls tests/__snapshots__

cards.title: Capture a live TUI pane in tmux at 80 by 24
cards.when: Use this when a terminal app must be checked as a real running process at a fixed size, not only inside a unit test.
cards.cmds:
tmux has-session -t lay
tmux capture-pane -p -t lay
tmux capture-pane -p -t lay
tmux kill-session -t lay

cards.title: Model loading, empty, error and ready as one enum
cards.when: Use this when a chart panel must switch between four display states without separate boolean flags.
cards.cmds:
cargo build
cargo test chart_state
rustfmt --check src/ui/chart_state.rs

cards.title: Make a text input fill its container width responsively
cards.when: Use this when building a text input that must shrink and grow with its parent on small and large screens.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p input-demo
touch input-demo/index.html
touch input-demo/styles.css
grep -n box-sizing input-demo/styles.css

cards.title: Prevent mobile browsers zooming on input focus
cards.when: Use this when a text input appears on phones and the page zooms in whenever a user taps the field.
cards.cmds:
cat input-demo/styles.css
grep -n font-size input-demo/styles.css
python3 -m http.server 8080
npx lighthouse http://localhost:8080 --only-categories=accessibility --output=json

cards.title: Enlarge input tap targets to 44px on touch screens
cards.when: Use this when a form is used on touch devices and inputs are too short for reliable finger taps.
cards.cmds:
python3 -m http.server 8080
grep -n 44px input-demo/styles.css
npx axe http://localhost:8080/index.html --exit

cards.title: Wrap an input and button row on narrow screens
cards.when: Use this when a search field sits beside a submit button and must stack vertically on small screens.
cards.cmds:
touch input-demo/row.html
touch input-demo/row.spec.js
grep -n flex-wrap input-demo/styles.css
npx playwright test input-demo/row.spec.js

cards.title: Size an input from its container with container queries
cards.when: Use this when the same input component appears in sidebars and main columns with different widths.
cards.cmds:
grep -n @container input-demo/styles.css
npx prettier --check input-demo/styles.css

cards.title: Scale input padding and font with clamp for fluid sizing
cards.when: Use this when input text and padding should scale smoothly between phone and desktop widths without breakpoints.
cards.cmds:
cat input-demo/styles.css
grep -c clamp input-demo/styles.css
touch input-demo/fluid.spec.js
npx playwright test input-demo/fluid.spec.js

cards.title: Plan empty-state copy, icon size, and contrast ratio
cards.when: Use this when the empty menu needs a message and icon, and the colors must be checked against a contrast requirement before building.
cards.cmds:
cat lib/theme/app_colors.dart
rg -n 'Colors.' lib/menu

cards.title: Plan the error state with a retry action and timing
cards.when: Use this when a menu can fail to load, and the error view needs a retry control with a stated response time.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -e Future -e fetch lib/menu
rg -n onRetry lib

cards.title: Define status prop union before modal code
cards.when: Use when the modal's empty and error states are driven by a single status value passed from a parent.
cards.cmds:
touch src/components/modal/types.ts
grep -o -E "'(idle|loading|empty|error|ready)'" src/components/modal/types.ts
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json

cards.title: Plan modal error and loading ARIA roles
cards.when: Use when deciding which ARIA role and live region each modal state needs before building the Vue template.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'aria-modal|Teleport' src
touch docs/modal-a11y.md
grep -n -E 'alertdialog|aria-live|200ms' docs/modal-a11y.md

cards.title: Set measurable size and contrast targets for states
cards.when: Use when the empty and error views need concrete numbers for text size, button size, and color contrast before styling.
cards.cmds:
npm ls vue
touch docs/modal-targets.md
grep -c -E '(44px|4.5:1|1rem|48px)' docs/modal-targets.md

cards.title: Plan one test per modal state and timing
cards.when: Use when deciding which Vue tests prove the empty and error states work before writing any test file.
cards.cmds:
find src -name '*.spec.ts'
touch docs/modal-test-plan.md
grep -c -E '^- test:' docs/modal-test-plan.md
npx vitest --version

cards.title: Plan a sealed MenuState class with four variants
cards.when: Use this when a menu loads data asynchronously and the widget must switch cleanly between loading, empty, error, and loaded views.
cards.cmds:
dart --version
mkdir -p lib/menu
touch lib/menu/menu_state.dart
dart analyze lib/menu

cards.title: Plan the golden test matrix for menu states
cards.when: Use this at the planning step to decide which golden screenshot tests prove the empty and error menu states in both themes.
cards.cmds:
rg -l matchesGoldenFile test
find test -maxdepth 2 -type d -name *menu*
flutter test test/menu

cards.title: Audit existing tab markup before planning the Vue tabs
cards.when: Use this first when a Vue project may already contain tab-like widgets that need an ARIA plan.
cards.cmds:
find src -name "*.vue"
grep -rln "tablist" src
npm ls vue

cards.title: Check tab color contrast before building
cards.when: Use when choosing tab colors so selected and unselected labels meet WCAG contrast before any code is written.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn "color" src/styles
npx axe http://localhost:5173

cards.title: Choose arrow key and activation behavior for tabs
cards.when: Use when deciding whether arrow keys select a tab immediately or only move focus to it.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn "keydown" src
grep -rn "ArrowRight" src
npx playwright test tests/tabs-keyboard.spec.ts

cards.title: Plan accessibility test coverage for tab components
cards.when: Use when planning which tests prove the Vue tabs are accessible before merging.
cards.cmds:
find tests -name "*.spec.ts"
npm ls @playwright/test
npx playwright test --list

cards.title: Plan tab tap targets at 48 and 44
cards.when: Use this when tab height, padding, or a SizedBox may shrink the touch area below the platform minimum.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -F -e "height:" -e "preferredSize" lib
rg -n -F -e androidTapTargetGuideline -e iOSTapTargetGuideline test

cards.title: Plan tab label contrast at 4.5 to 1
cards.when: Use this when planning the selected and unselected colors for TabBar labels.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -e labelColor -e unselectedLabelColor -e indicatorColor lib
rg -n -F "fontSize:" lib
rg -n -F textContrastGuideline test

cards.title: Full-width button below 600dp using LayoutBuilder
cards.when: A Flutter button must fill its parent width on phones and keep its natural width on tablets.
cards.cmds:
touch lib/widgets/responsive_button.dart
dart format lib/widgets/responsive_button.dart
flutter analyze lib/widgets/responsive_button.dart

cards.title: Enforce a 48dp minimum tap target with a widget test
cards.when: A responsive button must keep a 48dp minimum touch target at every width.
cards.cmds:
grep -n minimumSize lib/widgets/responsive_button.dart
touch test/responsive_button_test.dart
flutter test test/responsive_button_test.dart

cards.title: Clamp text scaling so labels fit at large font sizes
cards.when: Users with large system font settings must still see a button label that fits inside the button.
cards.cmds:
rg -n textScaler lib
flutter test test/responsive_button_test.dart

cards.title: Golden screenshot tests at 320, 600, and 1200 logical widths
cards.when: You need pixel-level proof that the button looks correct across phone, tablet, and desktop widths.
cards.cmds:
touch test/responsive_button_golden_test.dart
flutter test --update-goldens test/responsive_button_golden_test.dart
flutter test test/responsive_button_golden_test.dart
find test -name *.png -path *goldens*

cards.title: Wrap buttons on narrow widths to prevent RenderFlex overflow
cards.when: Two or more buttons sit side by side and must stay visible on a 280dp screen.
cards.cmds:
rg -n Row lib/widgets
flutter test test/responsive_button_test.dart

cards.title: Switch button density on orientation with a 200ms animation
cards.when: The button must change its padding when the device rotates, and the change must finish within 200ms.
cards.cmds:
rg -n AnimatedContainer lib/widgets
flutter test test/responsive_button_test.dart

cards.title: Inventory every TabBar and its tab labels
cards.when: Use this at the start of a Flutter accessibility pass, before any tab code changes.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -F "TabBar(" lib
rg -c -F "Tab(" lib
rg -c -F "Tab(icon:" lib
flutter --version
flutter test

cards.title: Plan screen reader names for TabBarView pages
cards.when: Use this when planning how each TabBarView page is announced to a screen reader.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -F "TabBarView(" lib
rg -c -F "TabBarView(" lib
rg -n -F "Semantics(" lib
rg -n -F bySemanticsLabel test
flutter test

cards.title: Plan arrow key navigation between tabs
cards.when: Use this when the app runs on desktop or web, where users expect arrow keys to move between tabs.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -F -e TabController -e "dispose()" lib
rg -c -F "TabController(" lib
rg -n -F sendKeyEvent test
flutter test test/tabs_keyboard_test.dart

cards.title: Plan 200ms tab switch with reduced motion
cards.when: Use this when planning the tab switch animation and how it changes when the user turns off animations.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -F -e animateTo -e "duration:" lib
rg -c -F "milliseconds: 200" lib
rg -c -F disableAnimations lib
rg -n -F "pump(" test
flutter test

cards.title: Confirm form text uses only semantic font tokens
cards.when: Use this after restyling a SwiftUI Form so you can prove no hardcoded font sizes remain.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn 'system(size' Sources/
grep -rn 'Font(.custom' Sources/Form
xcodebuild test -scheme FormApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:FormAppTests/FormTypographyTokenTests

cards.title: Verify form labels scale at accessibility Dynamic Type
cards.when: Use this when a form's layout must survive the largest Dynamic Type size without clipping or truncation.
cards.cmds:
xcrun simctl list devices available
xcodebuild test -scheme FormApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:FormAppUITests/DynamicTypeFormTests
grep -rn '@ScaledMetric' Sources/Form

cards.title: Set contrast targets for both themes before styling
cards.when: Use this when planning the onboarding palette so both themes are measured against the same numbers.
cards.cmds:
touch contrast-targets.txt
wc -l contrast-targets.txt
cat contrast-targets.txt

cards.title: Pick breakpoints for the tab layout before writing CSS
cards.when: Use this when you must decide the screen widths where a tab row changes layout.
cards.cmds:
grep -rl tablist .
grep -c class=tab-button index.html
echo breakpoints 480px 768px 1024px

cards.title: Set the minimum touch target size for tab buttons
cards.when: Use this when you plan the size of tab buttons for touch screens.
cards.cmds:
grep -n min-height styles.css
echo tab-target-min 44px
grep -n 44px PLAN.md

cards.title: Plan the media query that stacks tabs into panels
cards.when: Use this when the tab bar must turn into stacked panels below a set width.
cards.cmds:
grep -n @media styles.css
echo stack-below max-width 767px
grep -n 768px PLAN.md

cards.title: Check color token text pairs meet 4.5:1 contrast
cards.when: Use this when you add or change a color token used for form labels or error text and need proof of WCAG AA contrast.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn 'Color(' Sources/Tokens
find Sources -name '*.colorset'
swift test --filter DesignTokenContrastTests
rg -n '4.5' Tests/DesignTokenContrastTests

cards.title: Snapshot form at three Dynamic Type sizes
cards.when: Use this to lock the form's typography with snapshot images at default, large, and accessibility sizes before merging.

grep -rn 'dark' Tests/FormAppTests/FormSnapshotTests.swift
xcodebuild test -scheme FormApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:FormAppTests/FormSnapshotTests
find Tests/FormSnapshots -name '*.png'

cards.title: Verify form controls meet the 44 point tap target

grep -rn 'frame(height: [0-3][0-9])' Sources/Form
grep -rn 'minHeight: 44' Sources/Form
xcodebuild test -scheme FormApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:FormAppUITests/TapTargetTests

cards.title: Build form target and confirm token file wiring

find Sources/Tokens -name '*.swift'
xcodebuild build -scheme FormApp -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator'
xcodebuild test -scheme FormApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:FormAppUITests/TapTargetTests

cards.title: Name color tokens by role before picking values
cards.when: Use this when planning CSS custom properties so light and dark themes can share one set of names.

touch tokens-plan.txt
wc -l tokens-plan.txt
grep -c blue tokens-plan.txt
grep -c '4.5:1' tokens-plan.txt

cards.title: Plan the onboarding steps and where theme choice sits

wc -l onboarding-steps.txt

grep -c 44px onboarding-steps.txt

cards.title: Plan a scrolling tab strip for narrow screens

grep -c class=tab-button index.html
awk BEGIN{print 6*120}
grep -n -e scroll-snap-type:\ x\ mandatory PLAN.md

cards.title: Render a placeholder when the nav list is empty

grep -n fn src/nav.rs
cargo build
cargo test nav::tests::empty_shows_placeholder

cards.title: Show a one-line error banner above nav items

rustfmt --check src/nav.rs
cargo test nav::tests::error_banner_row_zero

cards.title: Keep nav selection valid when the list is empty
cards.when: Use this when the nav list may be empty and a key handler could select index zero and crash.

cargo test nav::tests::selection_empty
cargo build

cards.title: Fallback message when nav area is too small

cargo test nav::tests::tiny_area_fallback
cargo test nav

cards.title: Bind r key to retry nav load after error

rg -c --fixed-strings input-bg src/styles/tokens.css
rg -c color-scheme src/styles/tokens.css
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Audit dark settings page with Lighthouse and focus spec
cards.when: Use this to confirm focus rings and accessibility scores hold on the input form in dark mode.
cards.cmds:
npm run dev -- --port 5173
npx lighthouse http://localhost:5173/settings?theme=dark --only-categories=accessibility --quiet --chrome-flags=--headless
npx playwright test tests/input-focus.spec.ts --grep dark

cards.title: Move nav colors into Textual CSS variables
cards.when: Use this when the nav stylesheet still contains hard-coded hex colors that would ignore the active theme.

touch tests/test_nav_theme.py

pytest tests/test_nav_theme.py -q

cards.title: Bind a localized TextField placeholder to a String Catalog key
cards.when: Use when a SwiftUI TextField in the app target shows a hard-coded placeholder that must change with the device language.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn "TextField(" Sources
grep -n "strings" Sources/Localizable.xcstrings
grep -rn "search.placeholder" Sources
xcodebuild -exportLocalizations -project App.xcodeproj -localizationPath ./loc -exportLanguage fr
xcodebuild build -scheme App -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16'
xcodebuild test -scheme App -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:AppTests/LocalizationTests/testSearchPlaceholderGerman

cards.title: Check input fit under doubled pseudolocalized strings
cards.when: Use when an input screen must still show full placeholder and label text when strings are expanded for longer translations.
cards.cmds:
xcodebuild build -scheme App -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16'
xcrun simctl bootstatus booted -b
xcrun simctl launch booted com.example.app -NSDoubleLocalizedStrings YES
mkdir -p shots
xcrun simctl io booted screenshot ./shots/input-double.png
xcodebuild test -scheme App -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:AppUITests/InputFitUITests
test -f shots/input-double.png

cards.title: Install Textual and pytest-asyncio for headless modal tests
cards.when: Use this in a fresh Textual project before writing modal form tests, so run_test can drive the app without a real terminal.
cards.cmds:
pip install textual pytest-asyncio
python3 -m pip show textual
ls tests
pytest -q tests/test_modal.py

cards.title: Prove invalid name input gets the -invalid class
cards.when: Use this when the modal's Input fields declare validators and you must show that bad input is flagged by Textual itself.
cards.cmds:
rg -n validators= src/app/modal.py
pytest -q -k invalid_name tests/test_modal.py

cards.title: Keep Save disabled until the form validates
cards.when: Use this when the modal's submit button must stay disabled for empty or invalid input and enable once all fields pass.
cards.cmds:
rg -n disabled src/app/modal.py
pytest -q -k submit_enables tests/test_modal.py
pytest -q -k submit_disabled tests/test_modal.py

cards.title: Verify Escape dismisses the modal and returns None
cards.when: Use this when the modal must close on Escape without submitting, and the caller's callback must receive None.
cards.cmds:
rg -n escape src/app/modal.py
pytest -q -k escape tests/test_modal.py

cards.title: Confirm the modal fits inside an 80 by 24 terminal
cards.when: Use this when the modal must render fully in the classic 80 by 24 terminal size without clipping the Save button.
cards.cmds:
rg -n width src/app/modal.py
pytest -q -k fits_80x24 tests/test_modal.py
wc -l src/app/modal.py

cards.title: Check validation feedback arrives within 200ms
cards.when: Use this when the form must show an error within 200ms of a keystroke, and you need a measurable timing check.
cards.cmds:
pytest -q --durations=3 tests/test_validation.py
rg -n elapsed tests/test_validation.py
pytest -q -k within_200ms tests/test_validation.py

cards.title: Verify viewport meta and 16px input font at 320px

grep -n font-size styles.css
npx playwright screenshot --viewport-size=320,640 http://localhost:8080/form.html form-320.png
node check-inputs.mjs http://localhost:8080/form.html 320

cards.when: Use when inputs, checkboxes, or radio buttons must be easy to hit with a thumb on small screens.

touch tests/tap-size.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/tap-size.spec.ts
cat tap-sizes.log

npx axe http://localhost:8080/form.html --size 375x667 --save axe-375.json
grep -n color styles.css

test -f check-overflow.mjs
node check-overflow.mjs http://localhost:8080/form.html 320 768 1280
cat overflow-report.txt

npx playwright test tests/input-width.spec.ts

cards.title: Score mobile form accessibility with Lighthouse

pytest tests/test_form_loading.py -q

cards.cmds:
rg -n 'Colors\.' lib/menu
rg -c 'Color\(0x' lib/menu
flutter analyze lib/menu

cards.title: Verify runtime theme toggle updates menu colors
cards.when: Use this when the user can switch themes while the app runs and the open menu must repaint with new colors within 200 milliseconds.
cards.cmds:
flutter test test/menu_toggle_test.dart
flutter analyze test/menu_toggle_test.dart

cards.title: Plan a responsive two-column form grid
cards.when: Use this when a sign-up or checkout form has several fields that must stack on phones and split into columns on wider screens.
cards.cmds:
grep -c '<input' src/components/SignupForm.tsx
touch docs/form-layout-plan.md
grep -n 'grid-cols' src/components/SignupForm.tsx

cards.title: Plan error text color that passes contrast
cards.when: Use this when choosing the color for error messages so they meet the WCAG AA text contrast requirement on white backgrounds.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "text-red-(300|400)" src
touch docs/form-error-color.md

cards.title: Plan 44px touch targets for form controls
cards.when: Use this when planning input and button heights for a form that will be used on touch screens.
cards.cmds:
rg -c "h-8|h-9" src/components/SignupForm.tsx
find src/components -name "*.tsx"

cards.title: Plan the submit button row layout
cards.when: Use this when planning the footer of a form, where the primary and secondary buttons must stack on phones and sit side by side on wider screens.
cards.cmds:
find src -name "*Form*.tsx"
grep -c '<button' src/components/SignupForm.tsx

cards.title: Add an asset catalog color with light and dark variants
cards.when: Use it when a tab bar or screen needs one named color that changes automatically between Light and Dark appearance.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p ThemeDemo/Assets.xcassets/Surface.colorset
grep -c "luminosity" ThemeDemo/Assets.xcassets/Surface.colorset/Contents.json
xcodebuild -scheme ThemeDemo -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' build

cards.title: Define semantic theme colors with a custom Environment key
cards.when: Use it when many views need named roles like surface, label and accent that resolve differently per color scheme.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p ThemeDemo/Theme
grep -c 'Color("' ThemeDemo/Theme/Theme.swift
grep -rn "Color(red" ThemeDemo
xcodebuild -scheme ThemeDemo -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' build

cards.title: Tint a TabView and set its bar background
cards.when: Use it when a TabView must show a brand accent and a tab bar background that stays readable in both schemes.
cards.cmds:
touch ThemeDemo/TabRoot.swift
grep -c "toolbarBackground" ThemeDemo/TabRoot.swift
xcodebuild -scheme ThemeDemo -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' build

cards.title: Let the user override appearance with AppStorage
cards.when: Use it when the app needs a Settings option that forces Light, Dark, or follows the system.
cards.cmds:
touch ThemeDemo/AppearanceSetting.swift
grep -rn "preferredColorScheme" ThemeDemo
xcodebuild -scheme ThemeDemo -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' build

cards.title: Preview Light and Dark tab views side by side
cards.when: Use it when a tab view needs visible Light and Dark previews in the Xcode canvas before the build is checked.
cards.cmds:
grep -c "#Preview" ThemeDemo/TabRoot.swift
xcodebuild -scheme ThemeDemo -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' build

cards.title: Check menu item height and icon size in both themes
cards.when: Use this when a menu must keep Material touch-target sizes unchanged when the theme switches to dark.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p test
touch test/menu_metrics_test.dart
grep -n getSize test/menu_metrics_test.dart
grep -c ThemeMode.dark test/menu_metrics_test.dart
flutter test test/menu_metrics_test.dart

cards.title: Plan when validation errors appear and how
cards.when: Use this before building any form field so the team agrees on when errors show and how they link to their inputs.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "zod|yup|onBlur" src
grep -rc aria-describedby src/components

cards.title: Plan a fieldset group for radio and checkbox fields
cards.when: Use this when a form has several related radio buttons or checkboxes that need one shared label and screen reader grouping.
cards.cmds:
rg -c "radio|checkbox" src/components/SignupForm.tsx
rg -n "h-11|min-h-11" src/components/SignupForm.tsx
touch docs/form-groups-plan.md

cards.title: Verify tab order mirrors under dir rtl
cards.when: Use when tabs render inside an Arabic or Hebrew page and the tab strip must reverse order.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test tabs-rtl.spec.ts --project=chromium
grep -n boundingBox tests/tabs-rtl.spec.ts
grep -n dir= src/app/layout.tsx

cards.title: Confirm every tab meets 44px touch target
cards.when: Use after adding a locale whose labels change tab width, to confirm mobile tap targets stay at least 44px tall.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test tabs-touch.spec.ts --project=mobile-chrome
grep -n min-h-11 src/components/Tabs.tsx
grep -n 44 tests/tabs-touch.spec.ts

cards.title: Measure tab text contrast in each locale
cards.when: Use when tab colors change or a locale switches to a different font weight or size.
cards.cmds:
npm run build
npx axe http://localhost:3000/ar/tabs --exit
npx axe http://localhost:3000/de/tabs --exit
grep -n text-slate src/components/Tabs.tsx

cards.title: Verify tab-panel ARIA links and switch under 200ms
cards.when: Use after wiring tabs to panels to confirm screen readers and locale switches work with fast response.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test tabs-aria.spec.ts
npx playwright test tabs-timing.spec.ts --project=chromium
grep -n tabpanel src/components/Tabs.tsx
npx axe http://localhost:3000/en/tabs --exit

cards.title: Show table selection with a highlight symbol, not color
cards.when: Use this when a ratatui Table lets the user pick a row and the selection must stay visible under NO_COLOR or on a monochrome terminal.
cards.cmds:
rg -n Table::new src/ui
rg -n highlight_symbol src/ui
cargo test table_selection_marker

cards.title: Give every table column a plain text header label
cards.when: Use this when a ratatui Table shows columns whose meaning would be lost without visible labels for screen readers or copied text.
cards.cmds:
rg -n Table::new src
rg -n widths src
cargo test table_header_labels

cards.title: Honor NO_COLOR so table styles are removed
cards.when: Use this when the TUI colors table cells and must respect the NO_COLOR convention for users who need plain output.
cards.cmds:
rg -n NO_COLOR src
env NO_COLOR=1 cargo test
cargo test no_color_table_cells

cards.title: Hide low-priority columns below a width threshold
cards.when: Use this when the terminal may be narrower than the table, so columns must drop instead of clipping text mid-word.
cards.cmds:
tput cols
cargo test table_narrow_hides_columns

cards.title: Set Textual DataTable to row cursor with headers
cards.when: Use this when a Textual app shows a DataTable that screen reader users navigate by row and must hear column names first.
cards.cmds:
rg -n DataTable app
pytest tests/test_table_a11y.py -q

cards.title: Park terminal cursor on the selected table row
cards.when: Use this when a ratatui table must place the hardware cursor on the selected row so terminal screen readers follow the selection.
cards.cmds:
rg -n render_stateful_widget src/ui
cargo test table_cursor_follows_selection

cards.title: Verify tab tint resolves differently in light and dark
cards.when: Use this after changing a TabView accent color that must differ between light and dark appearance.
cards.cmds:
grep -c luminosity TabsApp/Assets.xcassets/TabAccent.colorset/Contents.json
xcodebuild build -scheme TabsApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16'
xcodebuild test -scheme TabsApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:TabsAppTests/TabAccentTests

cards.title: Snapshot tab bar in light and dark schemes
cards.when: Use this when a tab view's colors or layout change and you need pixel-level proof for both color schemes.
cards.cmds:
ls TabsAppTests/__Snapshots__
xcodebuild test -scheme TabsApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:TabsAppTests/TabsSnapshotTests
find TabsAppTests/__Snapshots__ -name '*.png'

cards.title: Force dark appearance on simulator for UI test
cards.when: Use this when a UI test must run with the simulator in dark mode and you need to reset it afterward.
cards.cmds:
xcrun simctl ui booted appearance dark
xcodebuild test -scheme TabsApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:TabsAppUITests/DarkTabsUITests
xcrun simctl ui booted appearance
xcrun simctl ui booted appearance light

cards.title: Check tab label contrast meets 4.5:1 in dark
cards.when: Use this after choosing dark-mode colors for unselected tab labels or the tab bar background.
cards.cmds:
grep -A4 dark TabsApp/Assets.xcassets/TabLabel.colorset/Contents.json
xcodebuild test -scheme TabsApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:TabsAppTests/TabContrastTests

cards.title: Measure tab switch under 200ms in dark
cards.when: Use this when changing tab content or dark-mode drawing and you need to confirm that switching stays fast.
cards.cmds:
xcodebuild test -scheme TabsApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:TabsAppUITests/TabSwitchPerfUITests
grep -n 0.2 TabsAppUITests/TabSwitchPerfUITests.swift

cards.title: Verify tab items meet 44pt tap target
cards.when: Use this when tab bar item sizes or icons change in dark mode and you need proof the tap area stays accessible.
cards.cmds:
grep -c XCTAssertGreaterThanOrEqual TabsAppUITests/TabTapTargetUITests.swift
xcodebuild test -scheme TabsApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:TabsAppUITests/TabTapTargetUITests

cards.title: Check translated tab labels fit 320px viewport
cards.when: Use when German or Finnish labels are longer than English and tabs may overflow or clip.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test tabs-overflow.spec.ts --project=mobile-320
grep -n overflow-x-auto src/components/Tabs.tsx
grep -n -F 'toHaveCount(0)' tests/tabs-overflow.spec.ts

cards.title: Verify every tab label key exists in all locales
cards.when: Use when adding or renaming tab labels so no locale falls back to a raw key string.
cards.cmds:
grep -n -F 't(' src/components/Tabs.tsx
node scripts/check-tab-keys.mjs
jq '.tabs | keys | length' locales/ar.json
jq '.tabs | keys | length' locales/en.json

cards.title: Plan text-scale and golden test matrix for onboarding
cards.when: You are deciding which screen sizes, text scales, and locales the onboarding golden tests must cover before writing them.
cards.cmds:
grep -n -F sdk pubspec.yaml
grep -rn -F textScaleFactor lib
find test -name '*onboarding*'

cards.title: Install and register the Tailwind forms plugin for onboarding
cards.when: Use when onboarding inputs render unstyled because the project has no form base styles yet.
cards.cmds:
npm install -D @tailwindcss/forms
grep -n content tailwind.config.js
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/styles.css -o ./dist/styles.css
grep -c appearance ./dist/styles.css

cards.title: Show a field error only after invalid input using peer-invalid
cards.when: Use when an onboarding email or required field must show its error message below the input once the value fails validation.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test tests/onboarding/email-error.spec.ts
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Style invalid fields with aria-invalid arbitrary variant classes
cards.when: Use when the onboarding form sets aria-invalid on a field and the border and ring must turn red to match.
cards.cmds:
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/styles.css -o ./dist/styles.css
npx axe http://localhost:5173/onboarding/profile

cards.title: Build a step indicator with a visible keyboard focus ring
cards.when: Use when the onboarding flow shows numbered steps that users can tab to and must see where keyboard focus is.
cards.cmds:
npx axe http://localhost:5173/onboarding/steps
npx playwright test tests/onboarding/steps-focus.spec.ts

cards.title: Disable the onboarding submit button with a 44px touch target
cards.when: Use when the onboarding submit button must stay disabled until required fields pass and must meet the 44px target size.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test tests/onboarding/submit-button.spec.ts
npx prettier --check src/onboarding

cards.title: Inventory list markup and set breakpoint plan
cards.when: Use this before editing any list component that must change layout across phone, tablet, and desktop widths.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -e '<ul' -e '<ol' src
find . -maxdepth 2 -name 'tailwind.config.*' -not -path './node_modules/*'
rg -c -e '<ul' -e '<ol' src
mkdir -p docs
test -s docs/list-responsive-plan.md

cards.title: Plan stacked list rows that widen at md
cards.when: Use this when a list item shows an image, title, and action that should stack on phones and sit in a row on tablets.
cards.cmds:
rg -n '<li' src/components
rg -n 'flex-row' src/components
rg -n 'md:flex-row' docs/list-responsive-plan.md

cards.title: Plan 44px minimum tap targets for list rows
cards.when: Use this when list rows contain buttons or links that must be easy to tap on phones.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'min-h-' src/components
rg -n '<button' src/components
rg -n '44px' docs/list-responsive-plan.md

cards.title: Plan hiding secondary list fields below md
cards.when: Use this when a list row has metadata such as dates or counts that clutters phone screens but should show on wider screens.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'updatedAt' src/components
rg -n 'hidden' src/components
rg -n '768px' docs/list-responsive-plan.md

cards.title: Plan viewport matrix for list tests
cards.when: Use this before writing tests so every list layout is checked at the widths where its classes switch.
cards.cmds:
find . -maxdepth 2 -name 'playwright.config.*' -not -path './node_modules/*'
npx playwright --version
npx axe --help

cards.title: Choose locales and confirm l10n.yaml setup
cards.when: You are deciding which languages onboarding ships in and need to confirm the Flutter localization config exists before writing ARB files.
cards.cmds:
grep -n -F flutter_localizations pubspec.yaml
cat l10n.yaml
find lib/l10n -name 'app_*.arb'
find lib/l10n -name 'app_*.arb'
flutter gen-l10n

cards.title: Budget text expansion for onboarding button labels
cards.when: You are sizing onboarding buttons and need to know how much longer German and other translated labels can be before they overflow.
cards.cmds:
jq -r 'to_entries[] | select(.key|startswith("onboarding")) | .value|length' lib/l10n/app_en.arb
jq -r 'to_entries[] | select(.key|startswith("onboarding")) | .value|length' lib/l10n/app_de.arb
flutter test test/onboarding_button_test.dart

cards.title: Plan directional layout for right-to-left locales
cards.when: You are preparing onboarding for Arabic or Hebrew and need to find the left and right layout values that must become start and end.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn -F left: lib/onboarding
grep -rn -F -e centerLeft -e centerRight lib/onboarding
grep -rn -F -e left: -e right: lib/onboarding
flutter test test/onboarding_rtl_test.dart

cards.title: Plan placeholders and plurals for dynamic onboarding text
cards.when: You are moving onboarding strings that contain variables or counts into ARB files with typed placeholders and ICU plurals.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn -F '${' lib/onboarding
grep -rc -F '${' lib/onboarding
flutter gen-l10n
flutter test test/onboarding_plural_test.dart

cards.title: Announce onboarding error summary with contrast-safe red text
cards.when: Use when the review step shows a summary of invalid fields that screen readers must announce and sighted users must read.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "role=.alert" src/onboarding
rg -n "text-red-700" src/onboarding
rg -n "href=.#" src/onboarding
npx axe http://localhost:5173/onboarding/review --tags wcag2aa
npx axe http://localhost:5173/onboarding/review --rules color-contrast

cards.title: Plan list layout by container width
cards.when: Use this when the list sits in a sidebar or card whose width differs from the viewport, so viewport breakpoints would be wrong.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'aside' src/components
rg -n '@container' src
ls docs
rg -n tailwindcss package.json
rg -n '24rem' docs/list-responsive-plan.md

cards.title: Run Lighthouse performance audit on onboarding route
cards.when: Use after building the SvelteKit onboarding flow to confirm the mobile performance score meets the target.
cards.cmds:
npm run build
npx vite preview --port 4173 --strictPort
npx lighthouse http://localhost:4173/onboarding --only-categories=performance --output=json --output-path=./lighthouse-onboarding.json --chrome-flags=--headless
jq .categories.performance.score lighthouse-onboarding.json

cards.title: Assert LCP and CLS budgets on onboarding with Playwright
cards.when: Use when the onboarding page renders hero content or step cards that could shift layout after Svelte hydrates.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/onboarding-web-vitals.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/onboarding-web-vitals.spec.ts --project=chromium

cards.title: Cap the onboarding route JavaScript chunk size
cards.when: Use after adding onboarding step components so the initial route stays within the JavaScript budget.
cards.cmds:
npm run build
find build/_app/immutable -name '*.js' -size +150k
find build/_app/immutable/nodes -name '*.js' -size +120k

cards.title: Verify onboarding step transitions finish under 200ms
cards.when: Use when a Next button in the onboarding wizard swaps Svelte components and the swap feels slow.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/onboarding-transition.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/onboarding-transition.spec.ts --project=chromium --repeat-each=5

cards.title: Limit onboarding network requests on first load
cards.when: Use when the onboarding page pulls in fonts, scripts, or images from many hosts and slows first paint.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/onboarding-requests.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/onboarding-requests.spec.ts --project=chromium

cards.title: Verify tab label contrast meets WCAG AA 4.5:1
cards.when: Use after building a Tailwind tabs component to confirm its colour tokens pass contrast in every tab state.
cards.cmds:
npm run dev
npx @axe-core/cli http://localhost:5173/tabs --tags wcag2aa --exit

cards.title: Confirm tab design tokens compile into built CSS
cards.when: Use after changing theme tokens in the @theme block or Tailwind config to prove the utilities were generated.
cards.cmds:
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/index.css -o ./dist/tabs.css --minify
grep -c tab-active ./dist/tabs.css
grep -c 875rem ./dist/tabs.css

cards.title: Assert tab font size and touch target with Playwright
cards.when: Use to prove computed font size and minimum tap height of tab buttons in a real browser.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright install chromium
npx playwright test tests/tabs-typography.spec.ts

cards.title: Gate tabs page accessibility score with Lighthouse
cards.when: Use before merging a tabs change to get a numeric accessibility score from the production build.
cards.cmds:
npm run build
npx vite preview --port 4173
npx lighthouse http://localhost:4173/tabs --only-categories=accessibility --output=json --output-path=./reports/tabs-lh.json
jq .categories.accessibility.score ./reports/tabs-lh.json

cards.title: Verify dark-mode tab tokens swap using dark variants
cards.when: Use when tabs use dark: variants or theme overrides and you need proof that both themes render different colours with passing contrast.
cards.cmds:
grep -c dark: ./src/components/Tabs.tsx
npx playwright test tests/tabs-dark.spec.ts

cards.title: Reject hardcoded colour and pixel values in tabs source
cards.when: Use at verify time to confirm tabs use design tokens and Tailwind scale classes instead of raw hex or arbitrary pixel values.
cards.cmds:
rg -n '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,6}' src/components/Tabs.tsx
rg -n 'px\]|rem\]' src/components/Tabs.tsx
npx eslint src/components/Tabs.tsx

cards.title: Confirm tab list scrolls instead of overflowing at 320px
cards.when: Use this after adding responsive CSS to a tablist that holds more tabs than fit on a phone screen.
cards.cmds:
python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory site
npx playwright test tests/tabs-overflow.spec.ts --project=chromium

cards.title: Measure each tab hit area at least 44px tall
cards.when: Use this when a tabs layout changes at phone widths and tabs must stay easy to tap with a finger.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test tests/tabs-touch.spec.ts --project=chromium --reporter=list
grep -c 'role="tab"' site/tabs.html

cards.title: Check layout switches at the 40em breakpoint
cards.when: Use this when tabs change from a horizontal row to stacked panels at a media query breakpoint.
cards.cmds:
grep -c '@media (min-width: 40em)' site/css/tabs.css
npx playwright test tests/tabs-breakpoint.spec.ts --project=chromium

cards.title: Scan tabs at mobile width for contrast and roles
cards.when: Use this after changing tab colours or stacking tabs, to confirm the narrow layout still meets WCAG contrast and ARIA rules.
cards.cmds:
python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory site
npx @axe-core/cli http://localhost:8000/tabs.html --tags wcag2aa --rules color-contrast

cards.title: Gate tabs accessibility score with Lighthouse at mobile size

python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory site
npx lighthouse http://localhost:8000/tabs.html --only-categories=accessibility --output=json --output-path=lh-tabs.json --chrome-flags=--headless
jq .categories.accessibility.score lh-tabs.json

cards.title: Reject fixed pixel widths in the tabs stylesheet

npx prettier --check site/css/tabs.css

cards.title: Plan a 256-color fade-in for empty-state message
cards.when: Use when a bash or terminal screen should fade an empty-state message in by stepping through gray tones, and the terminal color support must be confirmed first.

tput colors
tput setaf 244
rg -c setaf PLAN.md

cards.title: Plan a Textual CSS fade transition for empty state

rg -c transition app.tcss

rg -n 'motion-safe:transition' src/components/Toast.tsx

cards.title: Plan a staggered reveal driven by IntersectionObserver
cards.when: Use this when cards should fade in as they enter the viewport and the plan needs fixed thresholds and stagger values.
cards.cmds:
test -f card.js
rg -n 'IntersectionObserver' .
grep -c 'class=.card' index.html

cards.title: Plan a scroll-linked fade with a non-supporting fallback
cards.when: Use this when a card should fade with scroll position and the plan must keep cards fully visible in browsers without animation-timeline.
cards.cmds:
test -f card.css
grep -n 'animation-timeline' card.css
grep -n '@supports' card.css
node --version

cards.title: Plan an expand-to-detail transition with View Transitions
cards.when: Use this when a card should morph into a detail view and the plan has to name each shared element before writing script.
cards.cmds:
test -f card.js
rg -n 'startViewTransition' .
rg -n 'view-transition-name' .
grep -c 'class=.card' index.html

cards.title: Plan a frame budget and performance gate for card motion
cards.when: Use this when card motion is done and the plan needs numeric budgets before any browser test is written.
cards.cmds:
test -f index.html
wc -l card.js
curl -sI http://localhost:8080
npx lighthouse --version

cards.title: Inventory existing onboarding motion before planning changes
cards.when: Use this first when a team wants to add or change motion in an onboarding flow built with Tailwind.
cards.cmds:
find src -iname "*onboard*"
rg -n "transition|animate-|duration-|ease-" src/components
npm ls tailwindcss
touch docs/onboarding-motion.md

cards.title: Choose onboarding motion tokens with fixed millisecond values
cards.when: Use this when a team needs one agreed set of durations and easings before any onboarding component is written.
cards.cmds:
rg -o "duration-[0-9]+" src
cat docs/onboarding-motion.md

cards.title: Plan transform and opacity only transitions for onboarding
cards.when: Use this when onboarding steps animate in or out and the plan must avoid layout-triggering properties.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "transition-all" src
rg -n "transition-(width|height)|animate-(width|height)" src
rg -n "transition-all" docs

cards.title: Plan Tailwind keyframes and animation tokens in theme config
cards.when: Use this when onboarding needs named entrance and exit animations that are not in Tailwind's default set.
cards.cmds:
test -f tailwind.config.js
rg -n "@theme" src

cards.title: Set a measurable motion budget with a Playwright check
cards.when: Use this when onboarding motion must meet a stated time limit and the team needs a test to prove it in the verify stage.
cards.cmds:
npm ls @playwright/test
npx playwright test --list
rg -c "h-11|w-11|size-11" src/components/onboarding

cards.title: Define typography roles as Style functions in theme.rs
cards.when: Use this when a terminal list has no shared text styling and needs named roles for title, body, muted, and selected text.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p src/ui
touch src/theme.rs
cat src/theme.rs
grep -n theme src/main.rs
cargo check
grep -c "pub fn" src/theme.rs

cards.title: Plan reduced motion fallbacks for each animated onboarding step
cards.when: Use this when any onboarding step has an animation, so users who set reduced motion still get a working flow.
cards.cmds:
rg -c "transition|animate-" src/components/onboarding
rg -c "motion-reduce:|motion-safe:" src/components/onboarding
rg -n "transition|animate-" src/components/onboarding
cat src/components/onboarding/Welcome.tsx
rg -n "animate-onboard-in" src/components/onboarding
npx playwright test tests/onboarding-reduced-motion.spec.ts

cards.title: Make Textual card focusable with visible focus style
cards.when: Use when a Textual card must be reachable by Tab and must show focus with a border change, not color alone.
cards.cmds:
touch ui/card.py
grep -n focus ui/card.py
touch tests/test_card_focus.py
pytest tests/test_card_focus.py -q

cards.title: Render ratatui card title into TestBackend buffer
cards.when: Use when a Rust ratatui card must render text that a unit test can read back as plain characters.
cards.cmds:
cargo add ratatui
cargo test card_
rustfmt --check src/card.rs

cards.title: Enforce 4.5:1 contrast for card text colors
cards.when: Use when a theme defines foreground and background colors for card text and must pass the WCAG AA minimum.
cards.cmds:
touch ui/theme.py
grep -n MIN_CONTRAST ui/theme.py
touch tests/test_contrast.py
pytest tests/test_contrast.py -q

cards.title: Expose card key binding in Textual footer
cards.when: Use when a Textual card action must be triggered by the keyboard and listed in the footer with a readable label.
cards.cmds:
grep -n BINDINGS ui/card.py
touch tests/test_card_keys.py
pytest tests/test_card_keys.py -q
rg -n 'Open card' ui/card.py

cards.title: Keep card readable at 40x12 terminal size
cards.when: Use when a Textual card must stay fully readable in a small terminal and must not clip its title at the minimum supported size.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/test_card_small.py
pytest tests/test_card_small.py -q
tput cols

cards.title: Check every form field has an accessible name
cards.when: Use this after building a Svelte form to prove each input, select, and textarea is reachable by its label in a real browser.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p tests
npx playwright test tests/form-labels.spec.ts

cards.title: Fail the build on Svelte accessibility compiler warnings
cards.when: Use this in a Svelte project to catch missing label associations and invalid form markup before the browser test stage.
cards.cmds:
npm install -D svelte-check
npx svelte-check --fail-on-warnings
npx svelte-check --fail-on-warnings

cards.title: Run axe-core scans on the form page
cards.when: Use this after the form renders in a browser to find WCAG violations such as contrast, missing names, and invalid ARIA.
cards.cmds:
npm install -D @axe-core/playwright
npx playwright test tests/axe.spec.ts

cards.title: Test that validation errors are announced to screen readers
cards.when: Use this when a Svelte form shows inline validation errors and you must prove each error is tied to its field and announced.
cards.cmds:
npm install -D @testing-library/svelte jsdom
npx vitest run src/lib/SignupForm.test.ts

cards.title: Gate the form page on a Lighthouse accessibility score
cards.when: Use this as the final verify step for a Svelte form page before merging, to get one numeric accessibility score.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p reports
npm run build
npx lighthouse http://localhost:4173/signup --only-categories=accessibility --output=json --output-path=reports/a11y.json --chrome-flags=--headless --quiet
jq -r .categories.accessibility.score reports/a11y.json

cards.title: Count selects and their labels in the form
cards.when: After editing an HTML form, to confirm every select element has a matching label.
cards.cmds:
rg -c "<select" form.html
rg -c "<label for=" form.html
npx axe http://localhost:8080/form.html --rules select-name --exit

cards.title: Test select keyboard operation with Playwright
cards.when: After building or changing a select, to prove it works with only the keyboard.
cards.cmds:
ls playwright.config.ts
npx playwright test tests/select-keyboard.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Assert select touch target is at least 44px
cards.when: After styling a select, to confirm it meets the 44px minimum target size for touch users.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "select" styles.css
npx playwright test tests/select-size.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Check select focus ring contrast is 3:1
cards.when: After changing select focus styles, to confirm the focus indicator stands out against its background.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "outline: none" styles.css
npx playwright test tests/select-focus.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Require Lighthouse accessibility score of 0.95
cards.when: Before merging a form page, to confirm the overall accessibility score meets the 0.95 threshold.
cards.cmds:
python3 -m http.server 8080
npx lighthouse http://localhost:8080/form.html --only-categories=accessibility --output=json --output-path=./lh-form.json --chrome-flags=--headless=new --quiet
jq .categories.accessibility.score lh-form.json

cards.title: Verify keyboard focus order and visible focus ring
cards.when: Use this to prove a Svelte form can be completed with the keyboard alone and that every focused control shows a visible ring.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/focus.spec.ts
rg -n outline-width tests/focus.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/focus.spec.ts --project=chromium
rg -n -e name= -e email= -e password= -e type=submit src

cards.title: Verify empty onboarding state shows call to action
cards.when: Use when an onboarding list receives an empty items array and must render a Vue empty state with a button.
cards.cmds:
npx vitest run tests/unit/EmptyState.spec.ts
rg -n items: tests/unit/EmptyState.spec.ts
rg -n v-else src/components/onboarding/EmptyState.vue
rg -n emitted src/components/onboarding/EmptyState.vue tests/unit/EmptyState.spec.ts

cards.title: Verify error state exposes retry and alert role
cards.when: Use when a Vue onboarding step fails to load and must show an error message with a retry action.
cards.cmds:
npx vue-tsc --noEmit
npx vitest run tests/unit/ErrorState.spec.ts
rg -n role=alert src/components/onboarding/ErrorState.vue
rg -n defineEmits src/components/onboarding/ErrorState.vue

cards.title: Verify network failure shows recoverable error via Playwright
cards.when: Use when the onboarding API returns a server error and the user must see an alert and be able to retry.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test tests/e2e/onboarding-error.spec.ts --reporter=line
grep -c 500 tests/e2e/onboarding-error.spec.ts
grep -n 2000 tests/e2e/onboarding-error.spec.ts

cards.title: Check error text contrast with axe in onboarding
cards.when: Use when error styles in an onboarding route change and need a contrast check against WCAG 4.5:1.
cards.cmds:
npx axe http://localhost:5173/onboarding --exit
rg -n error-text src/styles

cards.title: Gate onboarding accessibility score with Lighthouse
cards.when: Use when a Vue onboarding change needs a measured accessibility score before merge.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p reports
npx lighthouse http://localhost:5173/onboarding --only-categories=accessibility --output=json --output-path=./reports/onboarding-a11y.json --chrome-flags=--headless=new
jq .categories.accessibility.score reports/onboarding-a11y.json

cards.title: Verify loading skeleton hides empty state until fetch
cards.when: Use when an onboarding list must show a skeleton while loading and never flash the empty state before data arrives.
cards.cmds:
npx vitest run tests/unit/OnboardingList.loading.spec.ts
rg -n advanceTimersByTime tests/unit/OnboardingList.loading.spec.ts
rg -n isLoading src/components/onboarding/OnboardingList.vue

cards.title: Plan a CardTokens ThemeExtension for radius and padding
cards.when: Use this when card radius, padding, and text roles must be shared and overridable across light and dark themes.
cards.cmds:
cat pubspec.yaml
rg -n "useMaterial3" lib
touch docs/card_tokens.md
flutter analyze

cards.title: Set card type scale and check 4.5:1 contrast
cards.when: Use this when choosing title and body sizes for a card and you must show the text is readable on its surface color.
cards.cmds:
cat docs/card_tokens.md
rg -n "surfaceContainerLow|onSurface" lib/theme
